verdict.rationale: Poke is described as a proactive assistant that can take on delegated tasks such as restaurant reservations, phone calls, orders and rides (with human help), and can build and deploy websites, draft emails, and run Recipe-based automations or external triggers. Together these imply asynchronous delegated work returned over messaging, but nothing explicitly describes autonomous multi-step background execution with a review step. Missing for 10: explicit docs on background or long-running multi-step task execution, a review/approval handoff of completed work, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
